verses.text: Ha winhaj Jerobaal, haton winhaj Gedeón, te ak'walto ix k'e wa'an winh yet' jantak heb' winh winak ayxo och yet'ok. Ha t'a sjaj ha' melem skuch Harod ix b'at sb'ok'e scampamento heb' winh. Haxo pax heb' madianita, ha t'a stojolal norte t'a yak'likal yich lum witz More, hata' ayek' scampamento heb'.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Gedeón chi' icha tik: Te tzijtum heb' winh winak tik het'nak. Tato swak'och heb' madianita t'a yol he k'ab' tiknaik, axom ol eyalani to yuj he jelanil ix eyak' ganar heb'.

Yuj chi' al t'a heb' winh soldado smasanil, tato ay mach xiw sb'at t'a owal chi', meltzajokab' t'a switzal Galaad tik, spax t'a spat, xchi t'a winh. Yuj chi' 22 mil heb' winh ix paxta, 10 milxonhej heb' winh ix kani.
Ix yalanxi Jehová: Hanheja' tzijtumto heb' winh soldado tik. Ik'b'at heb' winh yuk'ej ha' t'a sti' ha' melem. Hata' ol wil heb' winh, a in xo ol wala' machtak ol kan het'ok, xchi t'a winh.

Ix yik'anb'at heb' winh ixto kan chi' winhaj Gedeón yuk'ej ha' t'a sti' ha' melem chi'. Ix yalan Jehová: Masanil mach sb'echank'eta ha' t'a yol sk'ab' yuk'ej, ch'ok tzik'kanel t'a skal heb' winh tz'em kuman syuk'an ha', xchi t'a winh.
Ha heb' winh ix b'echank'eta ha' t'a yol sk'ab', ix yuk'ani, 300 heb' winh, haxo jantakxo heb' winh jun, ix em kuman heb' winh ix yuk'an ha' heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Gedeón chi': k'okb'il heb' winh 300 chi' ol in k'ana' yik ol eyak'an ganar heb' madianita chi'. Haxo pax heb' winh ix em kuman yuk'an ha ha' chi' jun, paxokab' heb' winh t'a spat, xchi t'a winh.

Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Gedeón chi' to smeltzaj heb' winh t'a spat. Haxo winh ix ik'ankanek' swa'el heb' winh yet' nok' sch'a'ak heb' winh spu'u. Haxonhej heb' winh 300 ix sik'jikanel chi' ix kan yet' winh. Ha scampamento heb' winh, ayek' t'a jolom witz t'a yib'anh b'aj ay scampamento heb' madianita chi'.
Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix yal Jehová t'a winhaj Gedeón chi': K'e'anh wa'an, ixik, emanh ak' owal yet' heb' madianita chi', yujto ol wak'och heb' t'a yol a k'ab'.
Tato tzach xiw a b'ati, emokab' winh a chekab' aj Fura het'ok t'a scampamento heb' chi',

ol he maklan eyab'i tas wan yalan heb', yuj chi' manh ol ach xiw och t'a owal chi', xchi t'a winh. Yuj chi' ix emk'och winh yet' winh schekab' chi' t'ak'walil b'aj ayel heb' stanhwan scampamento heb' madianita chi', yik smaklan yab' heb' winh tas syal heb'.

Ha heb' madianita chi' yet' heb' amalecita yet' heb' ix kot t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, ix majel sat lum ak'lik chi' yuj heb', ichok nok' k'ulub'. Manhxo b'ischajb'enok jantak nok' camello yet'nak heb', icha wal yarenail t'a sti' ha' mar.

Ayik ix k'och winhaj Gedeón chi' b'aj ayek' heb' wan stanhwan scampamento heb' chi', ix yab'an winh yalan swayich jun winh soldado t'a junxo winh icha tik. --Ix in wayichej to ay jun ixim pan cebada ix kot b'alb'on t'a sat witz tik. Ix emul ixim t'a yol ko campamento tik, ix och pok'naj ixim t'a jun mantiado, ix em lanhnaj yuj ixim, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi junxo winh chi' icha tik: --Ha jun ixim pan chi' syalelk'ochi to a winhaj Gedeón yuninal winhaj Joás yet' heb' soldado israel ol onh ak'an ganar. Yujto ha Dios ol onh ak'anoch ko masanil t'a yol sk'ab' heb', xchi winh.

Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Gedeón tas ix yutej yalan jun wayich chi' heb' winh, ix em kuman winh t'a yichanh Jehová, ix yak'an yuj diosal winh t'ay. Ixlajwi chi', ix k'exta winh t'a scampamento, ix yalan winh: --Koyek, yujto toxo ix yak'och heb' madianita Jehová t'a yol ko k'ab', xchi winh.

Ox makan ix yutej 300 heb' winh soldado chi' winh. Junjun nok' ch'a'ak ix yak' winh t'a junjun heb' winh soldado chi' yik spu nok' heb' winh, ix yak'anpax junjun chen winh t'a heb' winh, ayem staj heb' winh ayoch sk'ak'al t'a yol chen chi'.
Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Ayik ol in k'och t'a junxo stib'at scampamento heb' kajk'ol chi', tzeyil wal tas ol in k'ulej, icha pax chi' ol he k'ulejpax a ex tik.

Ha ol eyab'an in pu'an nok' ch'a'ak tik yet' heb' tzak'anoch wu'uj, ol he pu'anpax nok' heyik he masanil t'a spatiktak campamento chi', ol ex awajok. Ol eyalan icha tik: Kak'ek owal yuj Jehová yet' winhaj Gedeón, xe chi, xchi winh.

Ayik ix k'och winhaj Gedeón chi' yet' 100 heb' winh soldado ajun yet'ok t'a junxo stib'at scampamento heb' madianita chi' t'a chimilak'wal, hato wal sk'exlan sb'a heb' b'ab'el ayel stanhwej campamento chi'. Ha wal ta' ix spu sch'a'ak heb' winh yik winhaj Gedeón chi', ix smak'anpaxpoj schen heb' winh yet'nak.

Junnhej ix aj spu'an sch'ak heb' winh yet'nak t'a swach' k'ab' yox makanhil, junnhej pax ix aj smak'anpoj schen heb' winh, haxo sk'ab' heb' winh t'a sk'exanh ix tz'ikancha'anh staj, cha'anh ix awaj heb' winh: Kak'ek owal yuj Jehová yet' winhaj Gedeón, xchi heb' winh.
Ix kannhej tek'tek' heb' winh t'a spatik campamento chi'. Haxo heb' ajk'ol chi', yelk'olalxonhej ix b'at heb' elelal, ix el yaw heb' yuj xiwelal.

Ayik ix spu'an nok' sch'a'ak 300 heb' winh israel chi', haxo Jehová ix ak'an somchajb'at spensar heb' ajk'ol chi'. Munil a heb' ix laj smil-lajcham sb'a. Ay pax heb' ix el lemnajok, ix b'at heb' t'a Bet-sita t'a stojolal Zerera, masanto ix k'och heb' t'a smojonal Abel-mehola t'a slak'anil Tabat.
Ixlajwi chi', ix smolb'an sb'a heb' yinhtilal Neftalí yet' heb' yinhtilal Aser yet' masanil heb' yik Manasés, ix b'at heb' t'a spatik heb' madianita chi'.

Haxo winhaj Gedeón chi', ix schekb'at yalumal winh t'a heb' yinhtilal Efraín kajan t'a tzalkixtak, to sb'at heb' smak t'a elanhchamel t'a sjayil sti' ha' Jordán t'a Bet-bara, yakb'an manto k'och heb' ajk'ol chi'. Ix sk'anab'ajej heb' sb'ati.

Ix yamchaj chawanh heb' winh sat yajal yaj t'a heb' madianita chi' yuj heb', jun winh skuch Oreb, junxo winh skuchan Zeeb. Ha winhaj Oreb chi', ix miljicham winh b'aj ay jun k'e'en tenam, haton k'e'en ix skuchkan Oreb. Haxo winhaj Zeeb chi', ix cham winh b'aj ay jun tek'lab'el yal uwa, yuj chi' Zeeb ix sb'iejkan jun chi'. Ix b'atnhej heb' yinhtilal Efraín chi' t'a spatik heb' madianita chi', ix yik'ankot sjolom winhaj Oreb chi' heb' yet' yik winhaj Zeeb chi' t'a winhaj Gedeón chi' t'a sti' ha' Jordán chi'.
